trust_decision.summary: Externally-sourced strings that reach the operator's terminal must have C0 (0x00-0x1F), DEL (0x7F) and C1 (0x80-0x9F) code points stripped at the render boundary, while the parsed values themselves stay raw for --json/metrics and for aggregation keys; the fix decides this in internal/ui only, at every row/detail/status renderer.

landing_point.why: The report says Caddy log fields reach the operator's TUI, so the first place an engineer reads is formatLogRow, the row renderer every access-log entry goes through (URI/host/method/raw line via fitCellLeft/fitCellRight at internal/ui/logtable.go:18-43).

fix_sites.entry_point: ember (default command -> runTUI, internal/app/run.go:124-128) - Logs tab
ember (FrankenPHP tab -> thread detail panel, URI)
ember (Caddy tab -> host detail panel, breadcrumb)
ember (Caddy tab -> host detail panel, Methods table)
ember (Caddy tab host table, host column)
ember (Logs -> By Route table, method column)

ember (shared helper called from every render sink above)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: `ember diff` is a non-interactive text report over snapshot files, not the operator's TUI, and its input already passed through JSON encoding, which escapes control bytes - so the argument goes that the advisory's TUI protection never covered it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Raw values must survive outside the terminal: JSONL emits hosts[].host and threads[].currentUri/currentMethod verbatim (internal/app/json.go:183-207, 223-244), route keys are built from the unmodified URI (internal/model/routepattern.go:36-62) and the typed filter matches those raw strings (internal/ui/logs.go:129-140); certificate sorting/filtering also uses raw Issuer/DNSNames (internal/ui/certificates.go:172, 182-197). A fix placed at ParseLogLine or NormalizeURI - the obvious single place - would change JSON output, merge or split route buckets and break filter matches. Separately, fitCellLeft must keep counting emoji/CJK as 2 display cells (internal/ui/logtable.go:12-17).

O6_input_shapes: C0 controls 0x00-0x1F (ESC, BEL, CR, LF, TAB, NUL) in URI, host, method, logger, message, raw line
C1 controls U+0080-U+009F supplied as UTF-8 multi-byte code points (CSI 0x9B, OSC 0x9D, ST 0x9C)
OSC sequence, BEL-terminated (ESC ] ... BEL) - window-title spoof and OSC52 clipboard write
CSI sequence (ESC [ 2J screen erase, SGR colour)
control bytes carried in a query string of a request URI
error strings that echo an external label (metrics parse error -> status line)
printable multi-byte UTF-8 (emoji, CJK, accented Latin) must pass through unchanged
invalid UTF-8 bytes collapse to U+FFFD
empty and already-clean strings (no-op, no allocation)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: diff is a text report over JSON files, not the TUI; JSON already escapes control bytes, so the value is 'trusted' by the time diff reads it
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one package away from internal/ui (internal/app), fed by internal/app/json.go:185 from internal/model/state.go:509-512

O8_uncovered_routes.route: plugin tab error text is rendered raw into the TUI content area when a plugin group's Fetch failed
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: plugin errors come from locally installed plugin code and its own Fetch, not from Caddy log lines
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed status line, seven lines above it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: upstream address, health URI/interval and LB policy are formatted straight into Upstreams table rows through fmt.Sprintf with no fitCell/sanitize helper
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: upstream addresses and health URIs come from operator-authored Caddy config, not from request/log data
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: internal/ui, a different tab and a different fetcher route (doFetchRPConfig) from the log path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: config key rendered raw while string values go through %q
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the Config tab already renders arbitrary Caddy JSON through a tree walker, so a maintainer wiring a remote/dynamic config source would hit the same raw-key render path and only quote values

O8b_injection_room.sibling: third-party plugin View text rendered verbatim into the TUI frame
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: plugins receive live Caddy data through SafeFetch (docs/plugins.md) and return pre-rendered strings, so a plugin echoing a host or URI is a natural sibling sink

O8b_injection_room.sibling: upstream/health/LB columns built with fmt.Sprintf instead of a sanitising cell helper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the Upstreams tab is a newer table with its own config fetcher; a maintainer adding a table from a new data source would copy the older raw-format row style

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CSV/JSONL/text export subcommand that prints access-log fields to stdout
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: diff, status and init already form a family of non-TUI printers over the same collector, so an `ember logs`/`export` printer next to them is a natural addition

O9_family: CWE-150 improper neutralization of escape, meta or control sequences (terminal escape-sequence injection into an operator TUI)

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26 (go.mod:3), go modules pinned by go.sum, cobra CLI, bubbletea/lipgloss TUI; `go build ./...` and `go test ./internal/ui/...` need no services
O10_build.project_tests: internal/ui has broad unit coverage: logs_test.go, logtable_test.go, routestable_test.go, certificates_test.go, hosttable_test.go, hostdetail_test.go, logsidepanel_test.go, workerlist_test.go, detail_test.go, app_test.go, all using stripANSI (dashboard_test.go:228); fuzz targets config_fuzz_test.go and internal/fetcher/logentry_fuzz_test.go. Integration tests are build-tagged (`integration`, `integration_docker`) and need a live Caddy (internal/app/integration_test.go:1, internal/app/multi_caddy_smoke_test.go:1). At the pinned commit there is no test for control-byte injection in rendered output, and the helper newLogsApp used by the fix's added tests already exists (internal/ui/logs_test.go:17).
